description: Find configured database connections by parameters: host, port, database, type, read_only and/or metadata key-value pairs. All provided filters are combined with AND. Username/password filters are ignored. Returns the same sanitized shape as connection_list.

metadata.description: Metadata key-value pairs; every pair must match (AND)

password.description: Ignored: connections are never filtered by credentials

read_only.description: Match connections with this read_only setting

user.description: Ignored: connections are never filtered by credentials

username.description: Ignored: connections are never filtered by credentials

name: connection_find
